claims.text: A Strands Decider 2B distilled from Clef 27B knows how to operate a Jetson Orin, and a quantized, healed build under 1 GB runs fast and accurately on a Jetson Orin Nano as a lobes decider domain

honesty_conditions.text: the bundle that runs on the Nano is the same sha256-pinned artifact measured in final; nothing is rebuilt on the board
